headline: Argentina cash withdrawals hit historic low as electronic payments grow
summary: Cash withdrawals in Argentina fell to a historic low of 1.3 times per month per adult, while electronic payments grew 14.7% year-over-year according to central bank data.
why: Shifts away from physical cash toward digital and electronic transactions reflect changing consumer behavior and financial infrastructure adoption.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Central bank data shows declining physical cash usage alongside rising electronic payments.
